pages.text: A Tier 3 ammo material from Ice and Fire, usable only as fletching. Eight Stymphalian Bird Feathers provide one material unit at the Part Builder. Each feather can also be melted into 5 mB of molten copper.

Copper Feather Arrow: Arrows gain +2 initial speed and ignore gravity at first. They gradually slow down before gravity returns. The first unblocked hit on a creature scatters copper Stymphalian feather arrows in eight directions. They vanish on landing, cannot be recovered, and cannot trigger another burst.
